scope: Read-only continuous-time swept-envelope audit of both full-active B-splines against their accepted same-epoch/map_id occupancy snapshots in the second obstacle layout. No canonical source or configuration changed.

method.vehicle_envelope: PX4 x500 swept collision boxes plus nominal D435i housing; orientation-invariant model sphere radius 0.4819358707 m, centered at the D435i IMU origin.
method.continuous_sweep: Evaluate each spline every 1 ms over its full active interval. Expand sampled spheres by a derivative-control-polygon speed bound times the maximum sample step, conservatively covering the continuous interval between samples.
method.map_check: Intersect the conservative swept sphere with 0.1 m axis-aligned snapshot voxel boxes; classify raw unknown/free/occupied and independent inflation mask. Out-of-map cells fail closed.
method.identity: Both splines, the goal, and each snapshot match epoch and odom frame; requested and returned map_id match. Snapshot stamp deltas are +1 ms and 0 ms; depth source ages are 130 ms and 99 ms.

interpretation: Neither model-envelope sweep intersects a raw occupied voxel, but both intersect unknown and inflated cells and extend beyond the map's lower z boundary (-0.15 m). The model collision AABB alone reaches 5.3–5.5 cm below that boundary near the trajectory start. This blocks a known-free clearance classification; unknown/out-of-map overlap is not proof of physical collision. The 5.9/10.9 cm occupied-voxel margins are descriptive and do not include map, localization, tracking, latency, or braking error.
qualification: Planner-only source run; neither trajectory was executed. No controller, PX4, runtime truth, collision-contact, tracking, or flight evidence. GOAL C remains pending.
next_step: Reconcile the map's lower-z/floor representation and the vehicle's valid airborne start height before repeating full-envelope clearance in a fresh epoch; do not loosen unknown-space handling or the acceptance margin based on this diagnostic.
